findings.text: — §7 says each non-token sentence "goes on a conditioned template (§6)", but §6 adds only selection conditions and `TemplateEntry` (imas_standard_names/grammar/vocab_loaders.py:662-672, cited by §6 at ~678) carries just `base`, `segments`, `description` and `documentation`, and §2 defines both text fields as the pattern's *opening* noun phrase ("one description opening and one documentation opening per name pattern"). The token-definition carrier does not help: `ConceptEntry.definition` (vocab_loaders.py:628) is keyed by a single token, which §7 itself rules out for a combination sentence. So §7 names where each sentence is *selected* but not where it is *stored* or *rendered*; a worker cannot place the sentence without adding a field the plan does not declare, and appending it to `documentation` makes the opening no longer an opening. — WOULD_CHANGE_THE_PLAN: yes — without a declared sentence field the node implementing §6/§7 must invent the storage and rendering path, and §7's done-when ("each sentence appears on every name it describes") cannot be satisfied through the two mechanisms the plan declares.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `AppliedConcept` resolves at `terms.py:116`, the concept emission at `terms.py:~280` and the template subset test at `terms.py:~297`, `_vocabulary_definitions` at `vocab_loaders.py:~715`, the zone order at `~380` and the template list at `~678`; `imas-codex docs/evidence/fragments/sn-catalog-grouping/scg-near-duplicate-rulings.json` exists and carries the sentences.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §5 and §6 each name a negative control ("each test fails with its mechanism removed, recorded with `EXIT=`") and §7 names two ("fails with a sentence removed, and fails again with a sentence moved to its family's shared template"), each of which can fail as asserted.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the changed sections name no scratch path; gate evidence follows the dispatch contract to the run's own records, and §7's test is an in-repo suite, not a node-local temporary.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags reach any symbol or path named by the three sections.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §7 assigns each separating sentence to "a conditioned template", but no section declares a field on a template that can hold a sentence, so the mechanism §7 relies on has no place to store its text.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §5 (definitions on population/zone/aggregation tokens), §6 (template token conditions) and §7 (placing the separating sentences) each carry one deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §7's `data-links` ("concept-and-notation-registry#s5,concept-and-notation-registry#s6") resolve to the two sections it depends on, and the plan-level `plan-blocks=imas-codex:sn-house-style` edge is unchanged.
